''See also: [[Naian Blackflame Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Naian [[Blackflame]] is an [[Underlord]] and heir of the [[Blackflame]] lineage who fights on behalf of the [[Black dragons|black dragons]]. Described as a skeletal figure with matted hair and unkempt features, he possesses dark human eyes rather than the characteristic [[Blackflame]] eyes seen in others of his path. In combat, he utilizes a tail for defense and employs the [[Void Dragon’s Dance|Void Dragon's Dance]] [[technique]], which includes manifesting a wide, orange [[sacred instrument]] from his [[soulspace]]. He is also capable of growing fiery, dark crystal claws from his fingers. During battles, Naian has demonstrated significant resilience despite sustaining injuries such as cracked skin and a dislocated knee. His connection to the [[Path of Black Flame]] is linked to his mental control, where a weaker presence of the path in his [[spirit]] allows for greater cognitive stability. He has been involved in confrontations with [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]], and there have been efforts to restore his autonomy from the influence of the [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Naian [[Blackflame]] has been in battle with [[Lindon]], who absorbed his original [[Path of Black Flame]] and struggled against him for control of a [[Ruler technique]]. [[Fury]] expressed a desire for [[Mercy]] to crush Naian, and [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] is responsible for spraying his [[blood]] across the floor.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Black Dragon Prisoner}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Black Dragon Prisoner]] is known by his real name, Naian [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> During a confrontation where [[Fury]] desires [[Mercy]] to crush him in mere seconds, Naian is found shackled by [[scripted chains]] and a red scripted collar.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref> Although he lacks the characteristic [[Blackflame]] eyes, this fighter is the final descendant of the original royal family from the [[Blackflame Empire]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16" /> Having expected his current circumstances, Naian manifests a [[sacred instrument]] from his [[soulspace]] in the form of a squat, wide [[orange blade]] that glows like a sunset.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16" /> While still in [[chains]], he utilizes razor [[steel]], and [[Lindon]] eventually absorbs the original [[Path of Black Flame]] from him.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref>}}
